expires_today.title: Bundle - Indie Fears
expires_today.long_description:
Get into the spooky season with this new bundle of the creepiest indie games around! Discover what all the fuss is about with the much-memed space-set nightmare fuel game Mouthwashing. Keep a mystery train running and try not to run out of oxygen on the steep mountain slopes of Threshold. Flip burgers and keep your customers satisfied in the spooky cooking simulator send-up Kiosk. Those aren’t even the tip of the horror game iceberg featured in this bundle, so name your price and help support the Prevent Cancer Foundation charity with your purchase. And maybe keep a light on while you play. You never know.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 14th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Cozy After Dark Showcase Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Have some after hours fun with this bundle of cozy games set in the middle of the night! Follow a new vampire navigating a 19th century Eastern European town in Cabernet! Sneak into school at night and survive a botched séance in Fear the Spotlight! Help trapped souls in the afterlife and guide them toward closure in the emotional Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo! There’s even more atmospheric fun to be had in this bundle of cozy nighttime games, so grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Dames 4 Games with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 2nd, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: World Builders: Horrors and Haunts
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Give your games the spooky atmospheres and creepy environments they deserve with this giant bundle of horror game digital assets from Dekogon Studios! This collection of buildings, furniture, statues, and more features churches in which to set unearthly rituals, enormous castles for dragons or vampires to call home, post-apocalyptic apartment complexes, definitely haunted mansions, suburban homes perfect for some slasher fun, and more! Build your games, fill them with frights, and let your story take hold with this asset bundle, available at the price of your choosing! Pay what you want and support the Forest School Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Excel by Wiley
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Ready to woo your team with the sharpest Excel skills in the office? We’ve got you covered with an approachable bundle of ebooks on Excel and the greater Microsoft 365 suite! Jam‑packed with titles from the iconic For Dummies series like Microsoft 365 Excel Formulas & Functions For Dummies, 7th Edition and Excel Data Analysis For Dummies, 5th Edition, this amazing bundle by Wiley covers a wide range of beginner and intermediate topics to help meet you at your existing skill level. Experience Excel’s everyday power of simple data organization, powerful calculations, and more while helping to support Kiss the Ground when you learn with Humble Bundle.

expires_within_72h.title: Best-Sellers of Amigurumi by Meteoor Books
expires_within_72h.long_description: Brighten every shelf, desk, and corner of your home with adorable amigurumi! This craft ebook bundle from Meteoor Books and Amigurumi.com brings you step-by-step patterns for the sweetest crochet creations from whimsical gnomes and magical creatures to endangered animals and forest friends. You'll even find full wardrobes of miniature outfits for four lovable animal friends.  This bundle includes 24 ebooks of amigurumi patterns suitable for beginner and intermediate crafters, so get them now at the price of your choice, and support your favorite charity with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: DIY Halloween Displays and Holiday Gifts
expires_within_72h.description: Make it happen with DIY tech skills!
expires_within_72h.long_description: Unlock an epic collection of Make: ebooks with the all-new DIY Electronics Gadgets, Games, and More Bundle! Start your DIY journey with the Make: Encyclopedia of Electronic Components v1-3, a series of beginner-level reference resources designed to educate newcomers and experienced DIY enthusiasts alike. Or actualize your dreams of creating a mechanical companion with Make: Robotic Arms. Pay what you want for everything you need to build your own DIY tech and help support the Electronic Frontier Foundation with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Map Making MEGA Bundle Last Chance
expires_within_72h.description: Chart your own path to map making
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Passionate about building maps to great game worlds? Say hello to the Map Making MEGA Bundle. Whether it's dungeons and floorplans, starships and solar systems or even entire worlds, this treasure trove of assets and apps has what you need for your cartography. It includes practically everything either released by map-making experts ProFantasy Software, including the latest CC3+, Cartographer's Annual Vol. 1–17, every symbol set, dungeon, city and overland app they've ever released.

Map your world and help Save the Children at the same time!

All Humble Bundle customers will get a link to a secret backer level when the Campaign Cartographer 4 Kickstarter is launched. Follow the campaign now!



Keys Expire. Please redeem before November 3, 2027.

Pay what you want for topic-specific learning software and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!
